# @vllnt/logger

> Small structured logging package for the @vllnt ecosystem. Emits JSON log entries, has zero runtime dependencies, and never throws from a log call.

Scoped events (`auth.login`), levels `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`, and pluggable synchronous outputs. The Node.js backend preset reads `LOG_LEVEL` from `process.env` on each call and defaults to `warn`. There is no built-in redaction.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): Install, API, entry points and design decisions
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup and release flow
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): Version history and release notes
- [Agents](AGENTS.md): AI agent instructions for this codebase

## Entry points

- `@vllnt/logger`: core API and Node.js backend preset (`createBackendLogger`)
- `@vllnt/logger/convex`: `createConvexLogger`, no `process.env` access
- `@vllnt/logger/posthog`: `createPostHogOutput`
- `@vllnt/logger/testing`: `createTestOutput`
